# On-call Rotation Policy

Each engineering team runs a weekly on-call rotation with a primary and a secondary engineer.

## Schedule

The rotation hands over every Tuesday at 10:00 Pacific time. Handover includes a short written summary of open incidents.

## Response times

The primary on-call engineer must acknowledge a page within 7 minutes. If the primary does not acknowledge, the page escalates to the secondary after 15 minutes, and then to the engineering manager.

## Compensation

An engineer who is paged three or more times between midnight and 06:00 during one rotation receives a compensatory day off, to be taken within the following month.
